_comment: Machines page. route local = run on the deck's own mac; ssh = pipe box/fleet-logins.sh over `ssh <ssh> [wsl] sh -s` (no install on the box); push = the machine runs `sh fleet-logins.sh push http://<tailnet-ip>:3131/api/machines <id>` on a cron. Until S3, existing aliases use deploy-certs/current with the legacy user below. After the owner completes S3, role aliases use current-daily for deploy and current-admin for privileged logins; only Legacy mints update current. user is public login metadata for the Legacy coverage guard, not an instruction to change a host. The owner updates it when activating role aliases. `host` joins the machine to hosts.json sessions and leases.
